definitions.Pmatch: sum65 softmax probabilities; none is the66th category
definitions.candidate_entropy: Shannon entropy over65 spatial probabilities conditional on match; natural log and bits
definitions.two_target_bin_probability: sum probability at distinct supplied lo/hi target bins; sum once if lo==hi
definitions.quantiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; all supplied queries in each group; no acceptance conditioning
definitions.decisions: original66-way MAP and fixed summed65-mass>none; no threshold sweep

limits: POSITIVE/NONE/IGNORE are the existing supplied source labels, not a new physical label validation.
IGNORE probabilities are descriptive only; their acceptance is not counted as a valid correspondence.
Candidate entropy measures spread, not correctness, calibration or independent modes.
No locations, targets, logits, checkpoints or solver outputs are changed.
Partitions are reported separately; no model reselection or confidence threshold tuning occurs.
